snippet.title: Theatre of War Rearmed - Announcement and Playtest Teaser
snippet.description:
Command real-time WWII battles across the complete Theatre of War series, unified on the latest version of its original engine. Experience deep tactical combat, realistic ballistics, and over 100 missions, enhanced for modern systems. 

Sign up for the free playtest starting May 7 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097940/Theatre_of_War_Rearmed/
